events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.
events.summary: 3 Sheep Puzzle is a 2D Sokoban-style logic game with remote movement. Guide the sheepdog through the barn to complete each level. A minimalist, relaxing challenge, perfect for quick minds looking to test their ingenuity.

events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.

events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.
events.summary: Alyup: An insane power fantasy. Unleash a cosmic barrage of hyperspheres with godlike powers, ascend the vast reaches of space like blazing rockets to razor-edged arena clashes, rescue fallen allies in tactical duels, grind stats to forge apocalyptic strikes, or perish in one devastating flash!

events.title: Beso's Shawarma
events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.
events.summary: Beso's Shawarma is a short, narrative-driven horror game. A late-night call lures you on a surreal journey through empty streets to a sketchy shawarma shop. Talk to a cast of strange characters, make a terrifying choice, and try to escape a disjointed, looping nightmare.

events.title: Blazeo
events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.
events.summary: Hell's failed Eden must burn. As Lucifer's right hand, tear through endless hordes of grotesque mistakes. Grow stronger, spread fire, erase your master's shame.

events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.
events.summary: Blue Oath is a solo combat action-adventure game in which you play as a warrior swordfish who sets out on a journey to free a giant, cursed moray eel. Using powerful dash attacks, you can impale enemies and objects onto your beak, stack them, and throw them back as weapons or tools.

events.summary: Boby’s girlfriend has been abducted by a witch—race through 3 worlds and 18 levels to save her. Can you beat it in under 5 minutes?

events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.

events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.

events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.
events.summary: Bugscraper is a solo or co-op roguelike shooter. As you climb toward your tyrannical boss's office, you'll battle floor after floor of enemies. Using a wide arsenal of weapons and upgrades, mow them down and aim for the top!

events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.
events.summary: Battle your friends in this exciting PvP sudoku showdown! Run around nature-themed puzzle boards while avoiding dangerous pencil projectiles, making good use of power-ups, and, most importantly, fill in the missing numbers faster than your opponent.

events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.
events.summary: Chicken Blaster is a casual arcade shooter where quick reflexes are the key to victory. Shoot coins, avoid hazards, and see how long you can survive as the chaos ramps up.

events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.
events.summary: Cloudsea is a low-poly exploration game set in the clouds of the world of Cloudsea. Explore the floating islands of Cloudsea in airships, manage crew, gather resources, solve quests, trade, and fight in airship-to-airship and melee combat!

events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.
events.summary: Crystal Journey - Lum's Adventure is a captivating 3D puzzle/adventure game where your goal is to guide Lum, a brave light spirit, through a world filled with challenging puzzles and stunning environments. Rotate the levels, think creatively, and solve intricate puzzles to reach the magical purple crystal that hold the key to Lum's journey.

events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.
events.summary: A role-playing game featuring musical themes with an affinity for the sick and righteous. The story revolves around a deadly battle of the bands contest, where entrants can attack and be attacked with music.

events.title: Defense of Kyrath
events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.
events.summary: Tower defense meets roguelike in a fantasy kingdom. Position 9 wardens across enchanted forests, pastoral meadows, and volcanic badlands. 30+ enemies with resistances and weaknesses. A talent tree for meaningful progression. Climb the Folly - a 20-tier roguelike ascent. Kyrath will not fall.

events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.
events.summary: Grow your fleet of space ships in this incremental space game. Extract wealth from the asteroids and stations, unlock upgrades to find synergies, defend against pirates, and unlock [REDACTED]. Pin to your desktop and watch your empire grow while you do "more important" things.

events.notes: Automatically added from IGDB. Release date is synchronized; price is not.
events.summary: Machines that feel more real! SKY Agriculture specializes in a variety of modern seeding, fertilization, and soil cultivation equipment for efficient and sustainable farming systems, and joins the series. Twelve implements assist you on your farm, and feature enhanced physics, animation, and dirt accumulation, making these machines appear more realistic than ever.

Forgotten Blood is a first-person action RPG inspired by King’s Field and the Souls series. Explore an interconnected world filled with secrets, danger, and hidden paths.

With access to MAX Boosted Specials, Boosted Special Attacks with more impact and utility, her Boost Meter manipulation is second to none.
